population: current117 SID; each process paired premean has common 3/4 lags; complete background required only for adjusted comparison
outcomes: same nine prespecified P1/P2 premean processes; no new environmental metric or p/q family

interpretation: retrospective background-standardized environment comparison; empirical joint hull intersection only diagnostic, does not establish causal positivity or fully identical states
failure: insufficient/no joint support or nonestimable target => not estimated with exact reason, not fill or loosen thresholds
code_reuse: existing P4/P5 phase standardization implementation already synthetic-tested; wrapper to be independently checked before observed fit
